_doc: Additions to pokeruby's own maps that come from Emerald (postgame_maps agent, 2026-10-07; converter/gba.py map_additions: every reader through gba.Repo sees them). 'layouts': another layout of a map = one of its layouts plus setmetatile-style edits ({at, metatile, collision (bits 10-11), elevation (bits 12-15); the base's bits kept when not given}), used as an alt layout (data/hoenn_world.json alt_layouts); a layout whose id is its own base edits that layout in place (the Battle Tower island's PWT building, battle_tower 2026-10-08). 'events': event lists appended to the pokeruby map's own (map.json keys).

LAYOUT_BATTLE_TOWER_OUTSIDE._doc: The Battle Tower island with a second building, the PWT's entrance (user decision 2026-10-08, notes/DECISIONS.md: the PWT is reached separately, through a second building on the island; b2tools/models_standalone.py pwt, res 488). An in-place edit (id = base): plan_map.py, world.py, the terrain modules and outdoor_check.py all see the building as Sapphire's own. Spot: the east lawn, x 19-21, rows 10-12, door (20,12) facing south onto the lawn (20,13), the fewest changes to Sapphire's map: Sapphire's tiles there are grass and one shrub (19,10), nobody stands on them (the Bug Catcher's home (18,11) stays; his 1-tile wander box loses x 19), row 9 stays open so the strip east of the tower (rows 6-9, x 17-22) is still reached, and the sign (16,13), the other people, the stairs, the ferry attendant (19,24) and the ferry landing (19,23) are untouched. Its 3 x 3 metatiles are Sapphire's own tower porch (rows 6-8, x 13-15: canopy, door 0x25d in the middle), solid, elevation 0 as the tower's.

LAYOUT_ROUTE103_ALTERING_CAVE._doc: Route 103 after the game, with Emerald's Altering Cave mouth. Emerald (pokeemerald data/maps/Route103/scripts.inc Route103_OnLoad: call_if_set FLAG_SYS_GAME_CLEAR -> setmetatile 45, 5, METATILE_General_CaveEntrance_Top, TRUE; setmetatile 45, 6, METATILE_General_CaveEntrance_Bottom, FALSE) opens the mouth in the middle of its cliff's 5-tile foot, with a strip of land in front of it that its redrawn Route 103 has (row 7, x 44-49, between the cliff and the sea; Sapphire's cliff foot meets the sea there). On Sapphire's map: the same two metatiles in the middle of Sapphire's cliff foot (x 45-49 at row 6, corners at 45 and 49: x 47), Emerald's land strip (metatile 0x001, elevation 3) along it (x 45-48 at row 7, joining Sapphire's land at x 49) and Emerald's shore metatiles under it (row 8: 0x19a, 0x189 x3, 0x18a; row 7 x 44: 0x18a), the same tiles Emerald draws around its strip.

warp_events._doc: Emerald's Route 103 warp 0 -> MAP_ALTERING_CAVE warp 0 (Emerald (45,6), the middle of its cliff foot: here (47,6), see LAYOUT_ROUTE103_ALTERING_CAVE). dest_warp_id 256 = Black 2's dynamic warp (ov035 EventMapChangeWarp_CreateFromEntity: dest id 0x100 goes to GameData's next zone): Route 103's zone init sets it to the Altering Cave zone of the day (src/field_scripts/scenes/Route103_AlteringCave.inc). The mouth exists only in the post-game layout (map replace event 7): before, the door stands on the cliff with the sea in front at another height and never fires.

The PWT building's door (LAYOUT_BATTLE_TOWER_OUTSIDE above): warp 1, after Sapphire's tower door (warp 0), so the tower door keeps its index. dest_map B2_ZONE_192 = Black 2's own zone 192 (the PWT lobby), dest_warp_id 0 = its entrance mat (warp 0, tiles (14..16, 26)): b2tools/world.py standalone_door. The lobby's exit (zone 192 warp 0) is pointed back at this door by b2tools/patches/pwt.py.
